name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A row of menus that stays on screen, as in a desktop application: File, Edit, View, each opening a menu of items, checkbox and radio items and sub-menus, moved through with the arrow keys from one menu to the next.

meta.when: An editor or tool with many commands grouped by kind. For a site's navigation use navbar or navigation-menu; for one button's actions use dropdown-menu; on a phone, prefer a toolbar or a single menu.
